# BizTrait Market

> The professional marketplace for business software, SaaS, website hosting, cloud services, CRM, marketing, security, and productivity tools.

BizTrait Market helps businesses, IT buyers, and professional teams discover, compare, and purchase business software. Products span SaaS applications, CRM, marketing platforms, e-commerce, website hosting, cloud services, security, backup, developer tools, and business analytics. Every product is verified, transparently priced, and supported by real customer reviews.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of BizTrait Market, featured products, and top business software categories.
- [Marketplace](/marketplace): Featured products, best sellers, top rated, and recently updated business software.
- [Software](/tools): Searchable directory of every product on BizTrait Market.
- [Categories](/categories): Browse products by category — business software, marketing, CRM, hosting, security, e-commerce, developer tools, and analytics.
- [Integrations](/integrations): Connectors to the business platforms your team already uses.
- [Documentation](/docs): Setup guides, account documentation, and integration references.
- [Contact](/contact): Sales, customer support, and partnership inquiries.
- [HTML Sitemap](/sitemap): Complete page index for humans and crawlers.

## Optional

- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How BizTrait Market handles customer data.
